screenshots.alt: Headline “Log workouts, get stronger, stay motivated” in black and blue capitals, over an Apps We Love badge with 5 stars on a blue band
The Hevy logo over a tilted phone logging Bench Press (Barbell): 1h 15min, 6,800 kg, 18 sets, with 3 finished sets lifted out in green
Headline “Analyze your workouts” above the Squat (Barbell) page: a 3D model with the quads in red and a Heaviest Weight chart that climbs to 80 kg
Headline “Plan your routines” above the Workout tab: Start Empty Workout, New Routine, Explore and 2 saved routines with blue Start Routine buttons
Headline “Join a growing community” above a feed post by strongdavid: Chest Day, 44 min, 5,340 kg, 8 likes and 3 comments
Headline “Track measurements” above progress photos from 4 Feb 2022 and 6 Feb 2024 and a body weight chart that falls to 86 kg
Headline “Compare your strength” above jaumeros vs strongdavid on Bench Press: jaumeros is marked Stronger, with a one rep max of 93 kg vs 80 kg
Headline “Follow friends’ progress” above strongdavid’s profile: 56 workouts, 72 followers, 55 following, a blue Follow button and 3 hours this week
Hevy plan picker: Pro Monthly $2.99, Pro Yearly $23.99 picked, Pro Lifetime $74.99, and a blue Get Started button
Hevy Free and Pro table: 6 features, with Free capped at 4 routines and 7 custom exercises, then the cancel terms

ourRead: Yearly comes preselected at $23.99, or $2.00 a month: 33% under 12 months of the $2.99 Monthly, 50% under the App Store’s $3.99 Monthly.
Lifetime, $74.99, costs as much as 3.1 years of Yearly. It sits right under the selected plan and makes $23.99 look small.
Free logs unlimited workouts but stops at 4 routines, 7 custom exercises and 3 months of graphs. Pro lifts those caps and adds Hevy Trainer.

improvements.title: Print $2.00 a month on Yearly
improvements.detail: Monthly and Yearly each repeat the period: “Billed monthly”, “Billed yearly”. On the preselected Yearly row, swap “Billed yearly” for “$2.00 a month, save 33%”.
improvements.rule: Drop redundant labels. If the value explains itself, remove the label.

improvements.title: Take the paywall text to 4.5:1
improvements.detail: Yellow PRO, #F7D000 on the #F7F9FB page, measures 1.4:1, and white on the #008CFF button 3.4:1. Cut PRO from the 3 rows, since all are Pro, and darken the blue to #0072D6 for 4.8:1.
improvements.rule: Text contrast: at least 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for text 24 px and larger.

improvements.title: Name what Pro unlocks
improvements.detail: “Take your training to the next level” heads the Free vs PRO table. Write what the table shows: “Unlock Hevy Trainer, unlimited routines and your full graph history”.
improvements.rule: Make headlines specific. "Track 3 habits in 10 seconds a day" beats "Transform your life".

stylePrompt: Build a paywall in Hevy's style. Top to bottom: a logo bar, a semibold headline, a one-line subline, then 3 radio rows: Monthly, Yearly, Lifetime. Preselect Yearly with a 2 px blue outline and a filled radio. Each row: plan name in blue, full price below, billing line at right. Then a full-width blue button and a Free vs Pro table with blue checks. Type: Figtree, semibold headline, regular prices. Colors: white #FFFFFF (60) for the page, black #000000 (30) for text, bright blue #267EE8 (10) for the outline, button and checks. Show full prices only and skip the trial. Use my brand colors in the same 60/30/10 roles.
